financing_terms.equity_line: Standby Equity Purchase Agreement On October 24, 2025, the Company entered into a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement, pursuant to which the Company has the right to sell to an investor up to $20.0 million of its common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, subject to certain limitations and conditions.
